say:0:1028315001:0.text: Those were mana sprites! Wow, they run so fast...
say:0:1028315001:0.source_cn: 是魔花种子！它们跑得可真快啊……

say:1:1028315002:0.text: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.
say:1:1028315002:0.source_cn: 它们往陷阱方向跑了……我们继续追。
say:1:1028315002:0.male: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.
say:1:1028315002:0.female: They ran toward the trap. Let's keep up the chase.
